findings.claim: The minimap and the track card each have their own copy of the code that fits a closed [x, z] outline into an SVG box. Both copies find the bounds, scale to fit with padding, centre the result, round to 0.1 units with a private `r1` and build an `M…L…Z` path. The next outline drawing (B11's locked card, or a results thumbnail) would make a third copy.
findings.evidence:
src/ui/hud.ts:40 `const r1 = (v: number): number => Math.round(v * 10) / 10;` = src/ui/track-card.ts:22 `const r1 = (n: number): number => Math.round(n * 10) / 10;`.
hud.ts:135-146: `const xs = outline.map((p) => p[0]); const zs = outline.map((p) => p[1]); const minX = Math.min(...xs); … scale = Math.min((MAP_W - 2 * MAP_PAD) / w, (MAP_H - 2 * MAP_PAD) / d); ox = (MAP_W - w * scale) / 2 - minX * scale; oz = (MAP_H - d * scale) / 2 - minZ * scale; const pts = outline.map(([x, z]) => `${r1(x * scale + ox)} ${r1(z * scale + oz)}`); const path = pts.length ? `M${pts.join('L')}Z` : '';`
track-card.ts:26-33: `if (outline.length === 0) return ''; const xs = outline.map((p) => p[0]); const zs = …; const scale = Math.min((THUMB_W - THUMB_PAD * 2) / (maxX - minX || 1), (THUMB_H - THUMB_PAD * 2) / (maxZ - minZ || 1)); const ox = (THUMB_W - (maxX - minX) * scale) / 2 - minX * scale; … return `M${outline.map(([x, z]) => `${r1(x * scale + ox)} ${r1(z * scale + oz)}`).join('L')}Z`;`
The only difference is the guard for a zero-extent axis: `Math.max(…, 1e-6)` in the HUD and `|| 1` on the card.
findings.suggestedFix: In track-card.ts, export `fitOutline(outline, w, h, pad, minExtent)`. It returns `{ scale, ox, oz, d }`, where d is the path string, and it takes the extent guard as a parameter so each caller keeps its exact arithmetic. The HUD passes its 1e-6 floor; the card keeps its own `|| 1` guard via a wrapper. Alternatively, put it in a small new src/ui/outline.ts with the single `r1`. Then rebuild() uses scale/ox/oz for the dots, and outlinePath becomes a one-line call. Real tracks give the same numbers and strings. Check open PR #36 (B11 locked card) first, since it likely edits track-card.ts.

findings.claim: Ten UI/input exports are used only inside their own module: no other src file, test, harness or gates file imports them. The modules therefore look like they have a wider API than they do, as C007 found for render.
findings.evidence:
A grep over the repo (excluding node_modules, journal and spikes) finds each name only in its defining file:
- src/ui/layout.ts:9 `export const DESKTOP_MIN` and :17 `export const DESKTOP_QUERY` (used only at :17 and :21)
- src/ui/track-card.ts:25 `export function outlinePath` (used only at :39)
- src/ui/screen-change.ts:14 `export const SCREEN_CHANGE_MS` (used only at :53)
- src/input/keyboard.ts:7 `export const KEY_MAP`, :21 `ACTION_KEY` and :27 `PAUSE_KEY` (used only at :51-86)
- src/input/gamepad.ts:7 `PAD_BUTTON`, :10 `STICK_DEAD_ZONE` and :26 `stickSteer` (used only at :28-61)
By contrast, hitTest, GO_HIDE_TICKS, GO_GONE_MS and GO_GLIDE_SECONDS are imported by tests and must stay exported.
findings.suggestedFix: Drop the `export` keyword from those ten declarations and change nothing else. bestLapKey (best-laps.ts:6) is also only used locally, but its doc says B08/B11 reuse the key, so leave it. Skip outlinePath if the fitOutline finding is taken, since it reworks that function anyway.

findings.claim: Several selectors are split across two rules in the same file. title.css has two `.ui-track-card:focus-visible` rules a few lines apart. hud.css repeats `.ui-hud__timer`, `.ui-hud-best` and `.ui-hud-pos__n` as later second rules. Readers editing the first rule miss the second.
findings.evidence:
src/ui/title.css:120-123 `.ui-track-card:focus-visible { outline: …; outline-offset: …; }` and :127-130 `.ui-track-card:focus-visible { transform: translate(var(--ui-card-lift), var(--ui-card-lift)); box-shadow: var(--shadow-overlay); }`. The only rule between them is :124 `.ui-track-card[aria-checked='true']:focus-visible`, which has higher specificity and sets only outline-color.
src/ui/hud.css:31 `.ui-hud__timer {display…}` and :189 `.ui-hud__timer { isolation: isolate; }`; :117 `.ui-hud-best {…}` and :192 `.ui-hud-best { position: relative; z-index: 1; }`; :57 `.ui-hud-pos__n {font-size; color}` and :234 `.ui-hud-pos__n { display: block; }`. No rule in between sets isolation, position, z-index or display on these elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Move the declarations of each second rule into the first rule for the same selector and delete the second rule. In hud.css, keep the comment at :185-188 above the .ui-hud-new-best block. No property is set twice and no intervening rule sets these properties, so computed styles are unchanged. In hud.css this can go together with C034.

findings.claim: Since B08, two stylesheet header comments contradict the code. results.css says the navy menu ground is shared with the start screen, but the S6 start screen is dirt and lives in title.css. screens.css:1 still lists the dead finish panel and leaves out the results ground it holds.
findings.evidence: src/ui/results.css:1-2 `/* Results screen (S5). Tokens only. The navy menu ground is shared with the start screen (screens.css); …`. In fact src/ui/screens.css:9 says `/* Full-screen menus (results) on a solid navy ground. The start screen (S6) is in title.css. */`, and src/ui/title.css:7 has `.ui-start { … background: var(--color-dirt); }`. screens.css:1 reads `/* Finish panel, pause card, the triple stripe and the shared full-screen menu ground. */`, while the file's live content is .ui-screen, the .ui-results ground, the stripe and the pause card. Only .ui-finish__* (:43-62, dead, C012) is finish panel.
findings.suggestedFix: Comment-only edits. results.css:1-2 → `/* Results screen (S5). Tokens only. Its navy ground is in screens.css; rows and the roundel use .ui-value type. */`. This adds to C035, whose screens.css:1 wording should also mention the results ground.

confirmations.note: The type and transition block is still copied: src/ui/components.css:122-131 (.ui-button) and src/ui/touch-controls.css:54-63 (.ui-tc), which clones.md flags at :122 = :54. B09 (#31) has merged, so the blocker given in the history is gone.
The stripe band is still written twice: src/ui/screens.css:97-108 (.ui-pause__stripes) and src/ui/results.css:28-39 (.ui-results > .ui-stripes); only border-width differs. B08 (#30) has merged.
src/ui/race-ui.ts:21 still has the private msToTicks, and src/ui/countdown.ts:17 still writes `Math.ceil((GO_GONE_MS * TICK_HZ) / 1000)` inline. format.ts:5 still has only ticksToMs. #31 has merged.
src/ui/hud.css:121-124 (.ui-hud-best) and :197-200 (.ui-hud-new-best) still repeat padding, border-top: 0, border-radius and line-height 1. #31 has merged.

components.css:52 still says 'FINISHED', :63 'finish stats' and :77 'finish card'. screens.css:1 now reads 'Finish panel, pause card, the triple stripe and the shared full-screen menu ground.', which still names the dead finish panel. results.css:1-2 is also stale (reported as a new finding).
